reason: Focus is on position management and exits with random/varied entries plus 13-EMA trend filter; no concrete long-only daily entry rules provided.

universe.description: US stocks and ETFs selected randomly

setup.quote: Our basis or our decision of long or short was based on the slope of a 13-period estimated moving average.

entry.quote: whatever ticker symbol they made, then that was the stock that we picked.

stop.rule: Initial 2x ATR trailing stop, tighten to 1.5x at 2x ATR profit, to 1x at 4x ATR profit
stop.quote: we put in the 2x ATR stop... if we did get to a 2x ATR profit, then we'd use a dynamic system and we'd move up to 1.5x ATR... if we got to 4x ATR, we then moved to a 1x ATR stop

exits.rule: Trail stop only; no other exits

sizing.quote: we did 1% risk on every single trade.

ambiguities.issue: Long/short both used; engine is long-only
ambiguities.assumption: Treat as discretionary due to random entries and management focus
